name: Waste Trafficking and Illegal Dumping
description: Illegal collection, export, treatment or dumping of hazardous or regulated waste, often disguised as second-hand goods or recyclables and shipped to countries with weak controls. Profits come from avoided disposal costs and falsified treatment records.

sources.text: FATF, Money Laundering from Environmental Crime (2021)
Basel Convention on the Control of Transboundary Movements of Hazardous Wastes and their Disposal
UNEP and INTERPOL, The Rise of Environmental Crime: A Growing Threat to Natural Resources, Peace, Development and Security (2016)
Europol, public material on environmental crime and waste trafficking

exposure.rationale: Waste firms, shippers and brokers disguising waste as used goods; cash to informal tippers and rotating shell operators.

indicators.name: Waste shipped as used goods or recyclables
indicators.canon: Waste shipped as used goods or recyclables
indicators.desc: Containers described as used electronics, vehicles, plastics or metal scrap with signs of unsorted waste.
indicators.ctx: Containers described as used electronics, vehicles, plastics or metal scrap with signs of unsorted waste.
indicators.fp: Second-hand trade is huge and legitimate.

indicators.name: Collection firm paid low fees yet reporting large volumes
indicators.canon: Collection firm paid low fees yet reporting large volumes
indicators.desc: Waste firm bills clients far below market disposal rates.
indicators.ctx: Waste firm bills clients far below market disposal rates.
indicators.fp: Efficiency or subsidies may lower prices.

indicators.name: Licence or permit lacking or misused
indicators.canon: Missing, misused or unverifiable licence or registration
indicators.desc: Customer offering a regulated or permitted activity cannot evidence the required licence or registration, or operates under a licence held by another party.
indicators.ctx: Operator lacks the permit or uses another firm's permit for different waste.

indicators.name: Shipments to countries with weak controls and few recycling facilities
indicators.canon: Shipments to countries with weak controls and few recycling facilities
indicators.desc: Exports to destinations known as dumping sites.
indicators.ctx: Exports to destinations known as dumping sites.

indicators.name: Cash payments to landowners or drivers for dumping
indicators.canon: Cash payments to informal suppliers or ground-level operators
indicators.desc: Large or repeated cash payments to informal traders, producers or workers in extraction or supply chains.
indicators.ctx: Payments to farmers, quarry owners or drivers for tipping.

indicators.name: Short-lived waste companies with common directors
indicators.canon: Short-lived or rotating entities with common controllers
indicators.desc: Entities are repeatedly formed, abandoned or replaced by successors sharing directors, addresses or history of prior defaulted companies.
indicators.ctx: Companies appear, accumulate waste and vanish leaving liabilities.
indicators.fp: Contractors may fail for commercial reasons.

indicators.name: Mixed legal and illegal operations blending flows
indicators.canon: Mixed legal and illegal operations blending flows
indicators.desc: Legitimate recycler also receives mislabelled loads and commingled revenue.
indicators.ctx: Legitimate recycler also receives mislabelled loads and commingled revenue.

indicators.name: Adverse media or enforcement action over waste crime
indicators.canon: Adverse media on customer or associates
indicators.desc: Credible negative news, enforcement notices or investigations link the customer, its owners or associates to criminal, corrupt or regulated-sector misconduct.
indicators.ctx: Fines, seizures, or investigations tied to firm or owners.
